name: Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic (1937–1951)
description: A red field with a yellow hammer and sickle beneath a red star outlined in yellow in the upper hoist, above the initials 'БССР' in yellow.
history: Flag laid down by the constitution of 19 February 1937, adding the hammer, sickle and star to the plain red flag of 1927. It was replaced on 25 December 1951 by the red and green flag with the ornament stripe, the basis of the present flag of Belarus.
